methodology: Captured the six dated Fronds K–P percentages explicitly attributed to Nakheel's internal inspection on 10 March 2026. The official page does not expose a publication date, so first availability is the retrieval timestamp. The 26.75% overall progress figure is excluded because the page does not date that figure. Frond-level status is preserved as reported lifecycle evidence for the Palm Jebel Ali community and is not treated as the progress of every Palm Jebel Ali phase, a RERA observation, a handover, a price, or an appreciation input. No financial observation or forecast was added.
